candidate_A.name: MetaDrive Default Local State + LiDAR
candidate_A.description: MetaDrive default state-based local observation without explicit surrounding-vehicle tracks. Ego borders, offsets, and navigation are geometric state abstractions.

candidate_B.name: MetaDrive State + Navigation + 4 Surrounding Vehicles + LiDAR
candidate_B.description: Flat vector incorporating 16 surrounding vehicle values extracted directly from physics engine.

candidate_C.name: CourseEnv Compressed State
candidate_C.description: Heuristically downsampled representation with min-pooled LiDAR sectors.

candidate_D.name: Structured AgentInput Concept (Open Candidate)

structure.CoreObservation: 259D uncompressed local state, navigation checkpoints, and 240 LiDAR rays
structure.TrafficContext: Structured surrounding vehicle state (relative pos, vel) with explicit validity mask
structure.TaskContext: Read-only goal, route, and map context (reference path, lane geometry, speed limit)
structure.EvaluatorTelemetry: Strictly segregated private telemetry (ground truth trajectory, route completion, collision flags)

candidate_D.description: Decoupled architecture avoiding mixing an oracle traffic tracker directly into a flat observation vector.

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Distance to left road border divided by map total width (computed from lane geometry when side_detector lasers==0)
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.0 means touching or beyond left sidewalk
field_specifications_275D.stability: Depends on map total width definition

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Distance to right road border divided by map total width (computed from lane geometry when side_detector lasers==0)
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.0 means touching or beyond right sidewalk
field_specifications_275D.stability: Depends on map total width definition

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Normalized signed heading-deviation proxy based on dot product of heading vector with lane lateral vector
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.5 represents vehicle aligned with lane heading; 1.0 is +90 deg deviation, 0.0 is -90 deg deviation

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Current forward speed of the vehicle
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: ~0.0123 represents stationary vehicle (0 km/h with 80 km/h max)

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Current front wheel steering angle
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.5 represents wheels centered (straight); 0.0 is full left, 1.0 is full right

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Steering component of last executed continuous action (VERIFIED: MetaDrive docstring had this swapped with throttle!)
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.5 represents neutral steering (0.0 continuous input); 0.0 full left, 1.0 full right

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Throttle/brake component of last executed continuous action (VERIFIED: MetaDrive docstring had this swapped with steering!)
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.5 represents coasting/idle (0.0 continuous input); 0.0 full brake, 1.0 full throttle

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Current vehicle angular velocity magnitude (beta_diff / 0.1s)
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.0 represents zero angular change (pure straight motion)

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Lateral offset from current lane centerline (computed from lane geometry)
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.5 represents vehicle exactly on lane center; <0.5 is right of center, >0.5 is left of center

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Projection of distance to checkpoint 1 along vehicle heading
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.5 means checkpoint is lateral to vehicle

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Projection of distance to checkpoint 1 along vehicle right-hand side
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.5 means checkpoint directly ahead/behind

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Bending radius of lane leading to checkpoint 1
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.0 represents a straight lane

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Bending direction of lane leading to checkpoint 1
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.5 represents straight lane

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Angular difference between start and end heading of lane leading to checkpoint 1
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.5 represents straight lane

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Projection of distance to checkpoint 2 along vehicle heading
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.5 means checkpoint is lateral to vehicle

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Projection of distance to checkpoint 2 along vehicle right-hand side
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.5 means checkpoint directly ahead/behind

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Bending radius of lane leading to checkpoint 2
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.0 represents a straight lane

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Bending direction of lane leading to checkpoint 2
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.5 represents straight lane

field_specifications_275D.semantic: Angular difference between start and end heading of lane leading to checkpoint 2
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 0.5 represents straight lane

field_specifications_275D.semantic: 4 nearest detected vehicles within 50m cylinder broad-phase (4 values per vehicle: rel_pos_long, rel_pos_lat, rel_vel_long, rel_vel_lat)
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: CRITICAL: 0.0 is dummy PADDING for absent vehicle; 0.5 represents 0 relative displacement / 0 relative speed

field_specifications_275D.semantic: 240 distance detector rays sweeping 360 degrees counter-clockwise starting from 0 deg (direct ahead)
field_specifications_275D.neutral_or_zero: 1.0 means clear path / max range (50m); 0.0 means immediate collision or dropped ray
field_specifications_275D.stability: Dynamic and static obstacles (excludes static road borders)
